title: Remove redundant static files/image_config/constants/constants.yml (superseded by templated constants.yml.j2 from #27877)
author: securely1g
body:
## Description

Remove the static `files/image_config/constants/constants.yml` file. It is now redundant with the build-time templated constants introduced by #27877.

As of #27877 ("Add `ENABLE_FRR_SNMP_AGENT` build option to disable BGP4-MIB", merged), the image's `/etc/sonic/constants.yml` is generated at build time by rendering `files/build_templates/constants.yml.j2`:

```
# files/build_templates/sonic_debian_extension.j2
j2 files/build_templates/constants.yml.j2 | sudo tee $FILESYSTEM_ROOT/etc/sonic/constants.yml > /dev/null
```

`constants.yml.j2` carries the full constants content plus build-time conditionals such as:

```jinja
  frr:
    enable_snmp_agent: {{ 'true' if ENABLE_FRR_SNMP_AGENT == 'y' else 'false' }}
```

The static `files/image_config/constants/constants.yml` is now a parallel, hand-maintained copy of the same data that the template owns. Keeping both invites drift (any new build-time-conditional constant has to be duplicated by hand) and is a maintenance hazard. It should be removed and its remaining consumers pointed at the templated source.

## Why it should be removed

- The authoritative, build-rendered constants now come from `files/build_templates/constants.yml.j2`.
- The static file duplicates that content and must be kept manually in sync — it cannot express the build-time conditionals (e.g. `frr.enable_snmp_agent`) that #27877 added.
- Two sources of truth for `constants.yml` is error-prone.

## Remaining consumers to migrate first

This file is **not unused** — these references must be updated as part of (or before) removal, otherwise the VS image build and `sonic-bgpcfgd` unit tests break:

1. **VS docker image** — copies the static file into the container:
   - `platform/vs/docker-sonic-vs.mk:67` — `$(DOCKER_SONIC_VS_CONSTANTS): files/image_config/constants/constants.yml`
   - `platform/vs/docker-sonic-vs/.gitignore` — notes it is copied at build time from `files/image_config/constants/`
   - These should consume the rendered/templated `constants.yml` instead of the static copy.

2. **`sonic-bgpcfgd` tests** — use the static file as a fixture:
   - `src/sonic-bgpcfgd/tests/test_sonic-cfggen.py:9` — `CONSTANTS_PATH = os.path.abspath('../../files/image_config/constants/constants.yml')`
   - `src/sonic-bgpcfgd/tests/util.py:4` — same `CONSTANTS_PATH`
   - `src/sonic-bgpcfgd/tests/test_bgp.py:14` — `paths = ["tests/data/constants", "../../files/image_config/constants"]`
   - These should point at the templated source (rendered output, or a test fixture derived from `constants.yml.j2`).

## Proposed work

- [ ] Repoint `platform/vs/docker-sonic-vs.mk` (and the `.gitignore` note) to the build-rendered/templated `constants.yml` instead of the static file.
- [ ] Update `sonic-bgpcfgd` tests (`test_sonic-cfggen.py`, `util.py`, `test_bgp.py`) to source constants from the template (or a fixture rendered from it).
- [ ] Delete `files/image_config/constants/constants.yml`.
- [ ] Verify a VS image build still produces a correct `/etc/sonic/constants.yml`, and `sonic-bgpcfgd` tests pass.

## References

- Follow-up to #27877 — https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/pull/27877
- Template that now owns the data: `files/build_templates/constants.yml.j2`
- Build render step: `files/build_templates/sonic_debian_extension.j2`

linkedPullRequests.body:
## Description

Removes the redundant static `files/image_config/constants/constants.yml` and migrates its remaining consumers to the shared build template `files/build_templates/constants.yml.j2`.

The image's `/etc/sonic/constants.yml` is generated at build time by rendering `files/build_templates/constants.yml.j2` (see `files/build_templates/sonic_debian_extension.j2`):

```sh
j2 files/build_templates/constants.yml.j2 | sudo tee $FILESYSTEM_ROOT/etc/sonic/constants.yml > /dev/null
```

Since #27877, that template also carries build-time conditionals such as:

```jinja
  frr:
    enable_snmp_agent: {{ 'true' if ENABLE_FRR_SNMP_AGENT == 'y' else 'false' }}
```

The static `files/image_config/constants/constants.yml` was a parallel, hand-maintained copy of the same data. It cannot express those build-time conditionals, and keeping two sources of truth invites drift. This PR makes the template the single source.

Fixes #28011

### Why I did it

- The authoritative, build-rendered constants now come from `files/build_templates/constants.yml.j2`.
- The static copy duplicated that data and had to be kept in sync by hand.
- Two sources of truth for `constants.yml` is error-prone.

### How I did it

Migrated the two remaining consumers off the static file, then deleted it:

**VS docker image**
- `platform/vs/docker-sonic-vs.mk` — render `constants.yml` from `files/build_templates/constants.yml.j2` via `j2` (j2cli is already installed in the sonic-slave image) instead of `cp`-ing the static file. Pass `ENABLE_FRR_SNMP_AGENT` through so the VS image's constants match real images.
- `platform/vs/docker-sonic-vs/.gitignore` — update the "copied at build time" note to point at the template.

**sonic-bgpcfgd unit tests** (used the static file as a fixture)
- `src/sonic-bgpcfgd/tests/util.py` — add `render_constants()` that renders the template (`jinja2` is already a dependency) to a temp file and points `CONSTANTS_PATH` at it; defaults `ENABLE_FRR_SNMP_AGENT` to `y` (same default as `rules/config`).
- `src/sonic-bgpcfgd/tests/test_bgp.py` — use `render_constants()` for the production constants fixture instead of `../../files/image_config/constants`.
- `src/sonic-bgpcfgd/tests/test_sonic-cfggen.py` — drop the unused `CONSTANTS_PATH`.

**Removal**
- Delete `files/image_config/constants/constants.yml`.

### How to verify it

1. VS image build produces a correct `/etc/sonic/constants.yml`:
   ```
   admin@vlab:~$ cat /etc/sonic/constants.yml | head
   admin@vlab:~$ grep -A1 "frr:" /etc/sonic/constants.yml
     frr:
       enable_snmp_agent: true
   ```
2. `sonic-bgpcfgd` unit tests pass (they now render the template for the production constants fixture):
   ```
   cd src/sonic-bgpcfgd && pytest tests/test_bgp.py tests/test_templates.py tests/test_sonic-cfggen.py
   ```
3. No remaining references to the removed path:
   ```
   git grep image_config/constants   # only docs/none
   ```

Locally verified that the rendered template loads correctly (`constants.bgp.peers`, `constants.frr.enable_snmp_agent`) and that `load_constants_dir_mappings()` returns the expected peer types.
